name: am-renderer-workspace
description: Dev launcher for am-renderer preview-service backend + web-editor frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue.bold,green.bold" "cargo run -p preview-service" "npm --prefix packages/web-editor run dev"
scripts.dev:release: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "blue.bold,green.bold" "cargo run --release -p preview-service" "npm --prefix packages/web-editor run dev"
scripts.build: cargo build --release && npm --prefix packages/web-editor run build
